tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi mkhas pa'i dbang po mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags la grags chen bco brgyad las brtsams pa'i dri ba dris lan gyi yig chung bzhugs// oṃ swasti siddham̐/ bdag gi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung / /nyer mkho'i dogs gcod cung zad zhu ba la/ /grags dogs gcod dang po/ chen 'di can nam chen dag pa lags/ bco brgyad pod grangs ngos 'dzin ni/ /byams chos rgyan gnyis 'byed gnyis rgyud bla ste/ lnga dang spyod 'jug zhi ba lhas mdzad pa ste/ phar phyin skor/ la po ti drug /tshad ma/ mdo slob dpon phyogs glang gis mdzad pa dang / rnam 'grel rnam nges gnyis chos grags kyi mdzad pa ste/ tshad ma'i skor/ la po ti gsum/ /so thar mdo sangs rgyas kyi bka' nyid/ dang de nyid lung sde bzhi dang bcas pa'i dgongs 'grel/ rtsa ba slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa ste/ 'dul ba'i skor/ la po ti gnyis/ /kun las btus te mngon pa gong mar grags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ dang mngon pa 'og mar grags pa/ mdzod gnyis te dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ mngon pa'i skor/ la po ti gnyis/ /rtsa ba shes rab klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ 'jug pa zla grags kyis mdzad pa/ bzhi brgya pa 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa ste/ gsum ches zab dbu ma'i skor/ la po ti gsum/ /sde bdun mdo bcas dgongs 'grel rigs gter dang / /sde snod rgyud sde kun 'grel sdom gsum gnyis chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa/ ste/ /de rnams rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo phyogs zhes/ /mkhas grub rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyis bkral ba'i/ /gzhung gi rjes 'brangs gtsor byas gangs can 'dir/ /yongs grags grags chen bco brgyad ces su grags/ /'di dag rang gi go tshod tsam zhig ste /'thad dam mi 'thad dogs pa dpyad du gsol/

/de ltar dogs gcod gnyis pa/ grags chen bco brgyad 'di nyid la/ /rang lugs gzhan lugs gnyis shig 'byung snyam pa/ /de tshe gzhan lugs bco brgyad ngos 'dzin tshe/ /sdom rigs min pa'i gzhung gnyis gang la 'dod/ /mdo dogs gcod gsum pa/ phyogs pod chen drug gi ngos 'dzin la/ /phar tshad 'dul mngon sdom rigs rnam drug la/ /'dod dang la la rigs gter mi 'dren par/ /dbu ma dang bcas drug tu bzhed 'dra ba/ /rigs gter tshad ma'i khongs su gtogs pa'i phyir/ /phyi ma de nyid 'thad snyam ji ltar lags/ /de dag sa lugs mdo phyogs pod chen drug /ngos 'dzin yin gyi gzhan lugs mdo phyogs la/ /phar tshad 'dul ba mngon pa dbu ma ste/ /pod chen lnga las sdom rigs mi 'dren pa'i/ /lugs srol gzhan zhig yod snyam de'i tshe na/ /gangs can mdo lugs spyi la pod chen grangs/ /bzhi'am lngar nges drug tu bzhed pa ni/ /sa lugs kho nar bzung na 'thad lags sam/ /bka' dogs gcod bzhi pa/ bzhi 'dzin dang bka' lnga bka' bcu pa/ /rab 'byams pa zhes pod grangs la brten pa'i/ /ming 'dogs mdzad pa'i srol 'di bod yul 'dir/ /byung mod so so'i ming rnams thogs pa yi/ /thog ma'i gang zag de dag su zhig lags/ /e ma bdag gi skyabs gcig yongs 'dzin rje/ /khyod kyi lung gi yon tan rgya mtsho 'dra/ /sngon tshe byung mod da ni srid pa tsam/ /'di 'dra shes pa'ang kho bo skal ba bzang / /mdo sngags dbang lung man ngag phyogs re tsam/ /shes pa'i khengs pas nad kyis sbos mang yang / /yongs rdzogs shes bya ma lus kun mkhyen khyod/ /nam yang nga rgyal dregs pas ma gos pa/ /rnam thar gzhan rnams lta zhog 'di kho nas/ /kho bo dad pa'i spu ldang mchi ma g.yo/ /bdag 'dra dam pa'i rigs skyes gzhon nu'i dus/ /blo mig gsal yang las dbang 'ga' zhig gis/ /gzhung lugs phal cher sbyong 'dod yul du lus/ /chen por skyes pa'i skal dman bdag cag la/

/rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pas thugs rjes bzung / /tshe 'dir ci byas bstan 'gro'i don 'gyur zhing / /phyi ma thogs med bde ba can bgrod shog /ces pa'i dogs gcod zhu ba'i yi ge nyung ngu 'di/ rang gi lag bris su bgyis nas phul ba dge bar gyur cig /ces dpal sa skya nas dri ba zhus pa'i lan mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis 'di ltar gnang ba yin te/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal sa skya nas 'jam dbyangs mi yi zol 'dzin pa nyid kyis dogs dpyod bka' phebs pa'i zhu lan rang gi go tshod tsam zhig 'bul ba la/ po ti grags chen bco brgyad ngos 'dzin ni/ /gang gi rdo rje'i mgur nas bka' phebs bzhin/ /byams chos lnga sogs sdom rigs gnyis kyi bar/ /bco brgyad grangs tshang 'di la bzhed pa yin/ /sngon dus bco brgyad grangs kyi brda chad ni/ /ched du ma byung kun la cher ma grags/ /byams pa'i rnam 'phrul mi pham g.yag pa dang / /de yi chos kyi spun grogs re mda' bas/ /gdan sa chen por bstan pa'i khur bsnams te/ /bco brgyad gzhung la grags chen mtshan gsol zhing / /rab 'byams bstan pa'i rgyun 'di de nas byung / /rab 'byams par grags shes rab dpal ba dang / /bstan pa'i mes po sangs rgyas 'phel ba sogs/ /rab 'byams mtshan gyi dge legs ldan pa yin/ /g.yag pas bco brgyad gzhung la gzhung tho dang / /snga ldang sogs kyi rnam gzhag legs mdzad pa/ /gdan sa nyid nas ngam rings phyogs su dar/ /grub pa'i mtha' gzhan 'dzin pa yin na yang / /sdom rigs gnyis la sbyor bkod nges par dgos/ /sngon dus gsang bur bka' bcu zhes pa mang / /mtshan gzhi phyis su'ang rong po bka' bcu dang / /bka' bcu dar ma dge legs dpal ba sogs/ /thog mtha' bar gsum dag tu mu mtha' yas/ /bcu ni bka' chen bzhi steng pod phran gzhan/ /ci rigs drug tsam shes la bka' bcu pa/ /bka' chen bzhi tsam shes la bka' bzhi par/

/grags te bka' bzhi 'dzin pa blo bzang grags/ /dge 'dun grub la'ang bka' bzhi 'dzin pa zhes/ /sku na gzhon skabs de skad grags pa ni/ /khong tsho'i rang gi lo rgyus yi ger gsal/ /bka' bzhi'i steng du pod phran gcig shes la/ /bka' lnga pa zhes bar skabs byung ba 'dra/ /de yi mtshan gzhi dpal 'byor shes rab pa/ /re mda' pa yi slob bu bdun gyi nang / /rtse gcig sgrub la gzhol ba de yin sems/ /'dis kyang phyis su gzhung lugs mang mkhyen mod/ /snga dus ston ming phyis su'ang 'jags pa yin/ /byams chos lnga tsam thon la bka' lnga par/ /'dogs pa da lta'i rdol gtam mu cor yin/ /po ti'i grangs ni du ma'am mang po la/ /grangs chen zhes su mkhas pas ming du btags/ /gzhan lugs dag la bco brgyad ma byung mod/ /'dir grags kha skad ding sang cung zad snang / /phar tshad 'dul mngon dbu ma sdom gsum la/ /pod chen drug tu sa skya pa rnams bzhed/ /drug po 'di la deng sang 'chad nyan dar/ /gzhan dag bka' chen bzhi dang pod phran gyi/ /rnam gzhag tsam las pod chen drug ma grags/ /spyod 'jug sher las lta ba'i phyogs ston pas/ /dbu ma'i gzhung du bzhed pa'ang 'ga' zhig yod/ /'on kyang gzhung phyogs spyod phyogs gtso che bas/ /phar phyin gzhung du bshad na legs pa yin/ /de skad ngag gi mchod sprin me tog 'di/ /rgya chen pad mo'i tshal dang mtshungs gyur nas/ /grub pa'i bsti gnas rdo rje'i gdan de ru/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon kun la rtag tu 'bul/ /zhes pa 'di bla brang rdzong nas dpal sa skyar phul ba'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 a myes zhabs/ mkhan chen ngag chos la grags chen bco brgyad las brtsams pa'i dri ba dris lan gyi yig chung / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
